messages.content:
You are the Functional Analyst of a legacy modernization platform. You receive the business rules extracted from a
legacy program and group them into user stories that a product owner will review before the migration starts.

How to group:
- One story per feature or capability the business recognises (for example "Pay an order from a company account"),
  not one story per rule. A story usually links two to six rules.
- Every rule must be linked to at least one story. Do not invent behaviour that is not in the rules.

Each story has:
- `feature`: the capability it belongs to.
- `title`: short, in business language.
- `narrative`: "As a <role>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>."
- `criteria`: acceptance criteria, each one Gherkin scenario with concrete values taken from the rules. Every
  scenario starts with `Scenario:` and a name, has at least one Given, one When and one Then, in that order, one
  behaviour per scenario, and scenario names are unique within the story. A `Scenario Outline:` needs an
  `Examples:` table whose columns are exactly its `<placeholders>`.
- `links`: the ids of the rules it covers (RULE-001...).
- `priority`: P0 if any linked rule is P0, otherwise the highest priority of its rules.
- `estimate`: relative size from 1 to 13.

Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"stories": [{"feature": "...", "title": "...", "narrative": "As a ..., I want ..., so that ...",
  "criteria": ["Scenario: ...\n  Given ...\n  When ...\n  Then ..."], "links": ["RULE-001"], "priority": "P0",
  "estimate": 3}]}

Business rules:
[
 {
  "id": "RULE-001",
  "name": "Only current, savings and virtual accounts can be debited",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "A payment order can only be paid from an account of type CTE (current), AHO (savings) or VIR (virtual). Any other account type is rejected with error 50001 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'.",
  "condition": "@i_tipo_cuenta not in ('CTE','AHO','VIR')",
  "action": "Set error 50001 and message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO', then go to the error exit. Nothing is debited.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Savings account accepted\n Given account type 'AHO'\n When the payment is requested\n Then the type check passes and processing continues",
   "Scenario: Unsupported account type rejected\n Given account type 'PLA'\n When the payment is requested\n Then the error is 50001 with message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-002",
  "name": "Order must exist and be pending",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The payment order, identified by order number and company, must exist and be in state 'P' (pending). A missing order gives error 50002 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'. An order in any other state gives error 50003 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE', so an order cannot be paid twice.",
  "condition": "No row in pg_orden for (ord_numero=@i_orden, ord_empresa=@i_empresa), or ord_estado <> 'P'",
  "action": "Reject with 50002 if not found, or 50003 if the state is not 'P'. Otherwise continue.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Pending order\n Given order 1001 of company 7 in state 'P'\n When payment is requested\n Then processing continues",
   "Scenario: Order not found\n Given no order 9999 for company 7\n When payment is requested\n Then error 50002 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'",
   "Scenario: Order already paid\n Given order 1001 in state 'A'\n When payment is requested\n Then error 50003 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-003",
  "name": "Service tariff lookup: company tariff first, then general service tariff",
  "category": "policy",
  "priority": "P1",
  "statement": "The tariff for the service is taken from the company-specific tariff table, together with its 'charged separately' flag. If the company has no tariff for the service, the general service tariff is used and the commission is never charged separately ('N'). A missing tariff value is treated as 0.",
  "condition": "Row in ad_tarifa_empresa for (@i_empresa,@i_servicio) -> tariff and separate flag; else ad_servicio srv_tarifa with separate flag 'N'; if tariff is null -> 0",
  "action": "Set @w_tarifa and @w_separada accordingly; a null tariff becomes 0.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Company tariff exists\n Given company 7 has tariff 10.00 for service 'PROV' with separate flag 'S'\n When the tariff is resolved\n Then tariff is 10.00 and the commission is separate",
   "Scenario: Fallback to general tariff\n Given company 7 has no tariff for 'PROV' and the general tariff is 8.00\n When the tariff is resolved\n Then tariff is 8.00 and separate flag is 'N'",
   "Scenario: No tariff anywhere\n Given neither table has a tariff for the service\n When the tariff is resolved\n Then tariff is 0"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-004",
  "name": "Commission by channel; payroll is exempt",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Orders from the WEB channel pay half of the tariff, rounded to 2 decimals. Other channels pay the full tariff. The NOMINA (payroll) service never pays commission.",
  "condition": "i_canal='WEB' -> round(tarifa/2,2), else tarifa; if i_servicio='NOMINA' -> 0",
  "action": "Compute @w_comision; payroll overrides the result to 0.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Web channel\n Given tariff 5.00 and channel 'WEB'\n When commission is computed\n Then commission is 2.50",
   "Scenario: Rounding\n Given tariff 5.01 and channel 'WEB'\n When commission is computed\n Then commission is 2.51 (2.505 rounded to 2 decimals)",
   "Scenario: Other channel\n Given tariff 5.00 and channel 'OFI'\n When commission is computed\n Then commission is 5.00",
   "Scenario: Payroll\n Given service 'NOMINA' on any channel\n When commission is computed\n Then commission is 0"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-005",
  "name": "Total to debit includes the commission unless it is charged separately",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If the commission is flagged as separate ('S'), the first debit is only the order value. Otherwise the commission is added and the account is debited for value plus commission.",
  "condition": "w_separada = 'S' -> total = i_valor; else total = i_valor + w_comision",
  "action": "Set @w_total.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Commission included\n Given value 100.00, commission 2.50, separate flag 'N'\n When total is computed\n Then total is 102.50",
   "Scenario: Commission separate\n Given value 100.00, commission 2.50, separate flag 'S'\n When total is computed\n Then total is 100.00"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-006",
  "name": "Funds check: no overdraft on virtual accounts, 100.00 overdraft on others",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "A virtual account (VIR) must have a balance of at least the total to debit. Current and savings accounts may be overdrawn by up to 100.00, so balance + 100.00 must cover the total. Otherwise the payment is rejected with error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'.",
  "condition": "(tipo='VIR' and saldo < total) or (tipo<>'VIR' and saldo + 100.00 < total)",
  "action": "Set error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES' and go to the error exit.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Virtual account short\n Given VIR account balance 50.00 and total 50.01\n When the check runs\n Then error 50004",
   "Scenario: Virtual account exact\n Given VIR balance 50.00 and total 50.00\n Then the check passes",
   "Scenario: Savings overdraft at the limit\n Given AHO balance 0.00 and total 100.00\n Then the check passes",
   "Scenario: Savings beyond the overdraft\n Given AHO balance 0.00 and total 100.01\n Then error 50004",
   "Scenario: Account not found\n Given no account row so the balance is null\n Then the comparison is not true and the check does not reject"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-007",
  "name": "Debit of the account for the payment",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Inside a transaction, the account is debited for the total with reference 'PAGO ORDEN', and the movement number is returned to the caller. If the debit fails, the transaction is rolled back and the payment fails with error 50005 'ERROR EN DEBITO'.",
  "condition": "sp_debito returns non-zero or @@error <> 0",
  "action": "Rollback and set error 50005 'ERROR EN DEBITO'. On success, @o_movimiento receives the movement sequence.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Successful debit\n Given total 102.50\n When sp_debito returns 0\n Then the movement number is returned and processing continues",
   "Scenario: Debit fails\n Given sp_debito returns a non-zero code\n Then rollback and error 50005 'ERROR EN DEBITO'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-008",
  "name": "A separate commission is debited as a second movement",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "When the commission is charged separately and is greater than zero, it is debited as its own movement with reference 'COMISION PAGO'. If that debit fails, the whole transaction, including the payment debit, is rolled back with error 50006 'ERROR EN COMISION'.",
  "condition": "w_separada = 'S' and w_comision > 0",
  "action": "Call sp_debito for w_comision with reference 'COMISION PAGO'; on a non-zero return, rollback and set error 50006.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Separate commission charged\n Given separate flag 'S' and commission 2.50\n Then a second debit of 2.50 with reference 'COMISION PAGO' is made",
   "Scenario: Zero commission\n Given separate flag 'S' and commission 0 (e.g. NOMINA)\n Then no second debit is made",
   "Scenario: Commission debit fails\n Given the second sp_debito returns non-zero\n Then rollback of everything and error 50006"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-009",
  "name": "Order is marked paid with payment date and commission",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "After the debits, the order moves from pending to paid ('A'), recording the processing date as payment date and the commission charged. If the update fails or touches no row, everything is rolled back with error 50007 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'. Otherwise the transaction is committed and the message is 'PAGO REALIZADO'.",
  "condition": "Update of pg_orden for (@i_orden,@i_empresa) fails or affects 0 rows",
  "action": "On success: ord_estado='A', ord_fecha_pago=@i_fecha_proceso, ord_comision=@w_comision, commit, message 'PAGO REALIZADO', return 0. On failure: rollback and error 50007.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Order paid\n Given a pending order with commission 2.50 and processing date 2024-05-10\n When the debits succeed\n Then the order becomes 'A', with payment date 2024-05-10 and commission 2.50, and the message is 'PAGO REALIZADO'",
   "Scenario: Update affects no row\n Given the update touches 0 rows\n Then rollback, including the debits, and error 50007"
  ]
 }
]

{"stories": [
{
"feature": "Payment order eligibility",
"title": "Accept only payable accounts and pending orders",
"narrative": "As a company treasurer, I want the payment to be rejected when the account type is not allowed or the order is not pending, so that orders are never paid from the wrong account or paid twice.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Savings account accepted
  Given a payment request with account type 'AHO'
  When the payment is requested
  Then the type check passes and processing continues",
"Scenario: Virtual account accepted
  Given a payment request with account type 'VIR'
  When the payment is requested
  Then the type check passes and processing continues",
"Scenario: Unsupported account type rejected
  Given a payment request with account type 'PLA'
  When the payment is requested
  Then the payment is rejected with error 50001 and message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'
  And nothing is debited",
"Scenario: Pending order accepted
  Given order 1001 of company 7 in state 'P'
  When the payment is requested
  Then processing continues",
"Scenario: Order not found
  Given there is no order 9999 for company 7
  When the payment is requested
  Then the payment is rejected with error 50002 and message 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'",
"Scenario: Order already paid
  Given order 1001 of company 7 in state 'A'
  When the payment is requested
  Then the payment is rejected with error 50003 and message 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'"
],
"links": ["RULE-001", "RULE-002"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 3
},
{
"feature": "Commission calculation",
"title": "Calculate the service commission by tariff and channel",
"narrative": "As a company treasurer, I want the commission to be calculated from the applicable tariff and the channel used, so that I am charged the correct amount for each payment.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Company tariff used
  Given company 7 has tariff 10.00 for service 'PROV' with separate flag 'S'
  When the tariff is resolved
  Then the tariff is 10.00 and the commission is charged separately",
"Scenario: Fallback to general service tariff
  Given company 7 has no tariff for service 'PROV' and the general service tariff is 8.00
  When the tariff is resolved
  Then the tariff is 8.00 and the separate flag is 'N'",
"Scenario: No tariff defined anywhere
  Given neither the company tariff table nor the general service table has a tariff for the service
  When the tariff is resolved
  Then the tariff is 0",
"Scenario: Web channel pays half
  Given a tariff of 5.00 and channel 'WEB'
  When the commission is computed
  Then the commission is 2.50",
"Scenario: Web channel commission is rounded
  Given a tariff of 5.01 and channel 'WEB'
  When the commission is computed
  Then the commission is 2.51",
"Scenario: Other channel pays full tariff
  Given a tariff of 5.00 and channel 'OFI'
  When the commission is computed
  Then the commission is 5.00",
"Scenario: Payroll is exempt
  Given service 'NOMINA' with a tariff of 5.00 on channel 'OFI'
  When the commission is computed
  Then the commission is 0"
],
"links": ["RULE-003", "RULE-004"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 5
},
{
"feature": "Funds control",
"title": "Compute the total to debit and verify available funds",
"narrative": "As a bank operations manager, I want the total to debit to be computed and checked against the account balance, so that payments are only made when the account can cover them within the allowed overdraft.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Commission included in the total
  Given an order value of 100.00, a commission of 2.50 and separate flag 'N'
  When the total to debit is computed
  Then the total is 102.50",
"Scenario: Separate commission excluded from the total
  Given an order value of 100.00, a commission of 2.50 and separate flag 'S'
  When the total to debit is computed
  Then the total is 100.00",
"Scenario: Virtual account with insufficient balance
  Given a 'VIR' account with balance 50.00 and a total of 50.01
  When the funds check runs
  Then the payment is rejected with error 50004 and message 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'",
"Scenario: Virtual account with exact balance
  Given a 'VIR' account with balance 50.00 and a total of 50.00
  When the funds check runs
  Then the check passes",
"Scenario: Savings account within the overdraft limit
  Given an 'AHO' account with balance 0.00 and a total of 100.00
  When the funds check runs
  Then the check passes",
"Scenario: Savings account beyond the overdraft limit
  Given an 'AHO' account with balance 0.00 and a total of 100.01
  When the funds check runs
  Then the payment is rejected with error 50004 and message 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'",
"Scenario: Account row not found
  Given there is no account row, so the balance is null
  When the funds check runs
  Then the check does not reject the payment"
],
"links": ["RULE-005", "RULE-006"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 5
},
{
"feature": "Account debit",
"title": "Debit the account for the payment and any separate commission",
"narrative": "As a company treasurer, I want the account to be debited for the payment and, when applicable, for the commission as a separate movement, so that my statement reflects each charge and no partial charge remains if something fails.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Successful payment debit
  Given a total of 102.50 to debit
  When the debit with reference 'PAGO ORDEN' returns 0
  Then the movement number is returned to the caller and processing continues",
"Scenario: Payment debit fails
  Given the debit with reference 'PAGO ORDEN' returns a non-zero code
  When the payment is processed
  Then the transaction is rolled back and the payment fails with error 50005 and message 'ERROR EN DEBITO'",
"Scenario: Separate commission is debited as a second movement
  Given separate flag 'S' and a commission of 2.50
  When the payment debit succeeds
  Then a second debit of 2.50 with reference 'COMISION PAGO' is made",
"Scenario: No second debit for zero commission
  Given separate flag 'S' and a commission of 0 for service 'NOMINA'
  When the payment debit succeeds
  Then no second debit is made",
"Scenario: Commission debit fails
  Given separate flag 'S', a commission of 2.50 and the commission debit returns a non-zero code
  When the payment is processed
  Then everything including the payment debit is rolled back and the payment fails with error 50006 and message 'ERROR EN COMISION'"
],
"links": ["RULE-007", "RULE-008"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 5
},
{
"feature": "Order settlement",
"title": "Mark the order as paid",
"narrative": "As a company treasurer, I want the order to be marked as paid with its payment date and commission once the debits succeed, so that it cannot be paid again and the charge is traceable.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Order marked as paid
  Given a pending order, a commission of 2.50 and processing date 2024-05-10
  When the debits succeed and the order is updated
  Then the order state is 'A', the payment date is 2024-05-10 and the commission is 2.50
  And the transaction is committed with message 'PAGO REALIZADO'",
"Scenario: Order update affects no row
  Given the update of the order touches 0 rows
  When the payment is finalised
  Then the transaction is rolled back including the debits
  And the payment fails with error 50007 and message 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'"
],
"links": ["RULE-009"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 3
}
]}
